new_result.summary: A three-bank exact-rank-three signature-(2,1) family has unit diagonals, every physical principal pair PSD, globally balanced positive edge signs, all three nonzero eigenvalues of modulus >1, but every physical 2x2 normalized submatrix has s2<=10/m. Thus no universal fixed child-curvature scale for the r23 eight-coordinate packet follows from the bare target. The same family is uniformly paid after disjoint bank aggregation by ||p_Q||inf<=8sqrt(pi).

partner_application.actual_inequality: For the sign-frustrated companion bank family, ||p_Q||inf <= 6sqrt(pi)/(1-10/m), hence <=12sqrt(pi) for m>=20.
